services.name: Oceanfront Cabin
services.desc: Brown’s Bay Resort’s oceanfront cabins on Vancouver Island, BC, are luxurious and picturesque while providing visitors with a personalized theme for each different premium cabin. Located just a stone’s throw away from the Pacific Ocean, these vacation cabins offer you views of the Inside Passage, which is filled with wildlife and marine traffic bound for Alaska. Each of the luxury vacation cabins is equipped with a full kitchen, living room with gas fireplace, downstairs bedroom with a queen-sized bed, washroom with shower and tub combo, a second upstairs bedroom, and a large oceanfront deck with a barbecue.
